Both data/stop states test recv_divcnt > (cfg_divider >> 4) so bits are sampled after ~4 cycles instead of a full cfg_divider period, causing bit-slip from 0xa5 to 0xe0. Fix restores full-bit wait to cfg_divider in both states. Refs picosoc/simpleuart.v:20, picosoc/picosoc.v:190.", "patch_diff": "diff --git a/picosoc/simpleuart.v b/picosoc/simpleuart.v
--- a/picosoc/simpleuart.v
+++ b/picosoc/simpleuart.v
@@ -89,14 +89,14 @@
 				10: begin
-					if (recv_divcnt > (cfg_divider >> 4)) begin
+					if (recv_divcnt > cfg_divider) begin
 						recv_buf_data <= recv_pattern;
 						recv_buf_valid <= 1;
 						recv_state <= 0;
 					end
 				end
 				default: begin
-					if (recv_divcnt > (cfg_divider >> 4)) begin
+
